greeting: Hi, and welcome aboard Space Mission Design! I'm your astronaut. Launch a real rocket, send Apollo to the Moon, or design your own mission. New here? Press the tour button and I'll show you around.
maxq: Max Q. Passing through peak dynamic pressure.
karman: We have crossed the Karman line. Welcome to space.
parking: Parking orbit achieved. Standing by for the translunar window.
tliStart: T L I ignition. Burn under way.
tli: Translunar injection complete. We are on our way to the Moon.
coast: Translunar coast under way. Next stop, the Moon.
approach: Approaching the Moon. Preparing lunar orbit insertion.
captured: Lunar orbit insertion complete. We are in orbit around the Moon. Mission accomplished.
lostcontact: We have lost contact with the spacecraft.
